sparql.title: Linked Data & SPARQL Endpoint
sparql.description: Materialized RDF projection (Oxigraph) and read-only SPARQL 1.1 Protocol Endpoint.
sparql.unreachableHelp: Oxigraph is enabled but not responding at the configured URL. Please check whether the container is running and the Docker profile 'rdf' is active.
sparql.rebuildDescription: Synchronizes all published records of all 7 core types (objects, entities, places, occurrences, procedures, collections, storage locations) atomically from PostgreSQL into Oxigraph.
sparql.rebuildConfirm: Rebuild the entire triple store from PostgreSQL? This process runs asynchronously in the background.
sparql.rebuildSuccess: Rebuild queued — synchronization is running in the background.

presenceLock.title: Editing Lock (Presence Lock)
presenceLock.description: Controls what happens when a record is already being edited by someone else.
presenceLock.warningDescription: other people see a hint but can still edit the record.
presenceLock.blockingDescription: while the record is open, other people cannot save it.
